source_refs.note: Exercise 13.1, Question 7 (book page 248, PDF 253); answer key PDF 310-311. Key's 1, y = -5x - 8 is wrong; correct point (1, 0), y = x - 1.

blocks.prompt: 7 Find the coordinates of the point of tangency and the equation of the tangent line for \(f(x) = x^3 - 2x + 1\) at \(x = 1\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh bhi Question 6 jaisa sawal hai, bas yahan point of tangency (woh point jahan line curve ko chhooti hai) bhi alag se poocha gaya hai.
Humein \((1, f(1))\), slope \(f'(1)\), aur phir line chahiye.
Plan: \(f'(x)\) definition se, phir \(x = 1\) rakh kar point aur slope, aur point-slope form.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = x^3 - 2x + 1\), \(x_1 = 1\).
Find karna hai: point of tangency aur tangent line.
Tareeqa: definition (first principles / ab-initio, yani bilkul shuru se) se derivative: \(f'(x) = \lim_{\delta x \to 0} \frac{f(x + \delta x) - f(x)}{\delta x}\). Chaar steps yaad rakhein: (I) \(f(x + \delta x)\) likhein; (II) us mein se \(f(x)\) minus karein; (III) \(\delta x\) se divide karein; (IV) \(\delta x \to 0\) ka limit lein. Yeh tareeqa is liye ke Exercise 13.1 mein sawal khud 'by definition' maangta hai, aur power rule waghera abhi Section 13.6 mein aaenge; is liye shortcut nahi, poora limit ka safar dikhana hai. Kisi point par tangent ki gradient (slope / dhalaan) \(m = f'(x_1)\) hoti hai, aur tangent line ki equation point-slope form se: \(y - y_1 = m(x - x_1)\), jahan \(y_1 = f(x_1)\). Yaani humein teen cheezen chahiye: point ka \(x\), point ka \(y\), aur slope.

Step I aur II: \(f(x + \delta x) - f(x)\)
\[f(x + \delta x) = (x + \delta x)^3 - 2(x + \delta x) + 1\]
\[= x^3 + 3x^2\delta x + 3x(\delta x)^2 + (\delta x)^3 - 2x - 2\,\delta x + 1\]
\[f(x + \delta x) - f(x)\]
\[= 3x^2\delta x + 3x(\delta x)^2 + (\delta x)^3 - 2\,\delta x\]
Kyun: \((a + b)^3\) ka formula lagaya aur \(-2\) ko \(x\) aur \(\delta x\) dono se multiply kiya. \(f(x)\) minus karne par \(x^3\), \(-2x\) aur \(1\) cancel ho gaye.

Step III aur IV: divide aur limit
\[\dfrac{f(x + \delta x) - f(x)}{\delta x} = 3x^2 + 3x\,\delta x + (\delta x)^2 - 2\]
\[f'(x) = 3x^2 - 2\]
Kyun: \(\delta x\) cancel kiya aur phir \(\delta x = 0\) rakha. \(3x^2 - 2\) bacha.

Point of tangency
\[f(1) = 1 - 2 + 1 = 0\]
\[(x_1, y_1) = (1, 0)\]
Kyun: Point ka \(y\) hamesha original function \(f\) se aata hai. \(f(1) = 0\), matlab yeh point \(x\)-axis par hai.

\(x = 1\) par gradient
\[m = f'(1) = 3(1)^2 - 2 = 1\]
Kyun: Slope ke liye derivative \(f'\) mein \(x = 1\) rakha: \(3 - 2 = 1\). Slope \(1\) ka matlab line \(45^{\circ}\) par uthti hai.

Tangent ki equation
\[y - 0 = 1(x - 1)\]
\[y = x - 1\]
Kyun: Point-slope form mein \(m = 1\), \((x_1, y_1) = (1, 0)\) rakha. Yeh line \(x - y - 1 = 0\) bhi likhi ja sakti hai.

Tasdeeq
\[x = 1:\ y = 1 - 1 = 0 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Line mein \(x = 1\) rakha to \(y = 0\), yani line point \((1, 0)\) se guzarti hai.
blocks.final_answer: Point of tangency \((1, 0)\); gradient \(1\); tangent: \(y = x - 1\)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key (Question 6 ke saath jura hua) \(1,\ y = -5x - 8\) chhapti hai. Gradient \(1\) sahi hai, lekin line ghalat hai (yeh Question 6 wali line dobara likh di gayi hai; \(x = 1\) par yeh \(-13\) deti hai, \(0\) nahi), aur point of tangency diya hi nahi. Sahi: point \((1, 0)\), tangent \(y = x - 1\).
